text_block_list.text:
One day, walking into the trainer's office as usual—
It somehow felt cleaner than usual.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
! Yes!!
Just a bit of sweeping the floors and polishing the windows...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Such words are too kind!
Doing this much is only natural for one who serves their master!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(...Yes! Yes, yes!
He totally praised me!
I knew he'd notice!)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(Alright, I'll work even harder tomorrow...!
I'll polish every little detail until it shines—)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to serving you today as well,
my liege!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(Huh? No praise...?
Even though I wiped behind the lights and dusted off all the files on the shelves...)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(Why...? Normally,
they'd notice right away how hard I'm working
and how I'm feeling...)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(Was that just a coincidence...?
No, my liege would never do such a thing—)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(............
Could it be... the current "King" is—)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: (I'm in... insanely bad shape?!)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(No way... What on earth could be the cause...!?
Fatigue? Lack of sleep? C-Could it be... an illness!?)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...My Liege. May I ask you something?
Have you been feeling unwell lately?
choice_data_list: Nothing in particular comes to mind...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
('No idea in particular'...?
............ Could it be!?)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: (Does that mean... "the damage is concentrated around the heart"?!)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
S-Since when...?! 
For my Liege to harbor such "darkness"... Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"...Rest assured, my 'King.'
You have me... by your side."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
The dark clouds swirling around my master...
I shall dispel them with this blade!

...I don't quite understand what she means, but Durandal's expression is dead serious.
......

...No way. Could it be... that without me noticing at all,
a grave danger—a 'darkness'—has been closing in on me... all this time...!?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...There is one hope.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"To prepare our forces to purge the evil—
let us depart for the holy ground."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: It's the greengrocer from the shopping district.
And so... with no idea why it was even necessary, I ended up heading to the local shopping district to buy ingredients for a vegetable hot pot.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...It's simmering quite nicely now.
Back home, I too was the hot pot commander—no,
the Chevalier de Bouillabaisse.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
This is a secret elixir passed down in my family.
I trust it will aid in enriching both your mind and body.

...I see. In preparation for the crisis looming
over me, you mean I must first nourish myself
and build up my strength?
And—taking a bite of that secret miracle cure, or rather, the vegetable hot pot—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: !? I-Is everything all right?!
choice_data_list: —It's kelp and dried shiitake dashi broth!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Wha...!? You can tell there's dried shiitake mushroom dashi in here, not just kelp...!?

"Roughly chopped ingredients backed by
a deep, rich flavor... What a magnificent hot pot!"
I praised Durandal for his cooking.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(To see right through the secret ingredient in an instant...
...That's the sharp intuition of the "King" I know!
Which means—could it be?!)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...My Liege. Could it be... could it be...
that your spirits have lifted!?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...Y-Yes, we did it!!!!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
T-Thank goodness... Thank goodness...!
As expected of my family's secret recipe...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for telling me, Mom—
...Mother!
choice_data_list: Heh... with this, I can stand against the "darkness"...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The nutrients of light have purged
the darkness that plagued the King...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: "However, we must not let our guard down! Please, have seconds...! So that you are never swallowed by the darkness again!"
And so... urged on by Durandal, I finished off the heart-and-soul-warming hot pot.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Huh? No... I believe the darkness
has already vanished, though...?

...I suddenly feel like the rug was pulled out from under me.
It turned into an awkward atmosphere,
but anyway—the hot pot was delicious!
